description: This script dynamically loads a C++ shape functions module, generates serialized shape function code, and writes C++ source code for shape function mappings and serialization utilities for PyTorch's JIT compiler.

methods.name: gen_serialized_decompisitions
methods.description: Generates serialized code for shape functions, batching them into strings with length constraints.

methods.name: gen_shape_mappings
methods.description: Creates C++ code for shape function mappings from schemas to function names.

methods.name: gen_bounded_mappings
methods.description: Creates C++ code for bounded shape function mappings.

methods.name: write_decomposition_util_file
methods.description: Writes the complete C++ source file with shape function serialization and mappings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that determines the PyTorch directory and initiates writing the C++ source file.
